title: Power Rankings: Lakers hold off Bulls at No. 1
heading: 2010-11 Power Rankings: Week 20
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Wish I had a dime for every time I heard this on press row Saturday night: Bet the Lakers are glad now that they didn't trade Bynum. And the rich get richer: L.A. doesn't have to play another road game until April 1.
